[.walkthrough]
.Add a checkbox to the form
. In *Edit* mode, click *UI Library* in the toolbar. The [.walkthrough-look]#library# has sections for layouts, content, input fields, and more.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/ui-library/01-open.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/ui-library/01-open.jpg"]
. Type in its search field to find a component, here [.walkthrough-look]#Checkbox#.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/ui-library/02-search.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/ui-library/02-search.jpg"]
. Drag it into the view. Drop zones light up as you go: between the form and the buttons, it goes into the view, between the two. Copilot adds it to [filename]#ContactView.java#.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/ui-library/03-drag.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/ui-library/03-drag.jpg"]
